title: Very comfortable and filled out quickly.
text:
Very comfortable and filled out quickly.. We love the mattress! It is so comfortable to sleep on, and I get a better sleep at night compared to my older mattress. I wake up less times, than with my previous mattress, during the night.

The mattress was easy to move while in the box and easy to unpack. It filled out in minutes and was usable almost right away. Recommended.

product_metadata.title: Serta 12" Gel Mattress, Queen, Off- Off-white
description: Our new Serta mattress in a box offers you the quality you depend on in the Serta brand, shipped directly to your door in a box! the Serta perfect Sleeper 12" gel memory foam mattress offers dual layer advanced cooling gel memory foam which contours to your pressure points for a perfect night of sleep! our cooling cover will keep you sleeping cool and sound all night long!.
